originality.rationale: The same normalized body-to-body states, signed Grover coins, and B1/B2/B3 numerical observations are present in arXiv:2604.11620v1, section 4.1. Its B3 body-to-body statement identifies times 31, 69, 93 as exactly unit fidelity, whereas the exact full-graph transfer formula proves strict inequality for all such finite times for m>=2 and establishes dense near-unity subsequences for every m>=2, plus a sharp m=1 obstruction. Other inspected primary literature concerns marked leaves on a star, +1 coin-eigenspace transfer, or unmarked Grover Cayley graphs, and does not assert this all-m signed-body-coin theorem. Searches identified no directly covering statement; this is a best-knowledge comparison, not proof of literature uniqueness.
